candidate_labels: Solitary Fibrous Tumor of the Bladder

Inflammatory Myofibroblastic Tumor: Histologic finding: infiltration of the bladder wall by an atypical spindle cell proliferation
Histologic finding: histologic features of myofibroblasts arranged in sheets with focal myxoid areas
Immunohistochemical finding: positive for vimentin and ALK-1
Immunohistochemical finding: focally positive for cytokeratins 8/18/19, muscle specific and smooth muscle actins, and desmin
Histologic finding: prominent nucleoli and nuclear pleomorphism
Histologic finding: numerous normal mitotic figures (5/10hpf) and a few abnormal ones
